resources.string: OwnIt Guard notices when you open TikTok, Instagram or YouTube. If you open them directly, it sends you to OwnIt first so you can say what you\'re looking for. When your chosen time is up, it covers the app and brings you back to OwnIt. OwnIt Guard only checks which app is open. It never reads what you watch, type or see.
Your minutes left today, and a quick way to search on purpose.
OwnIt: stay on what you came for

During a search visit started in OwnIt, OwnIt keeps you on your search: if TikTok\'s For You feed opens, it takes you back to your results. When you open Reels in Instagram or Shorts in YouTube, swiping on to the next one takes you one step back. To do this, Android lets it look at the screen of those apps; OwnIt only checks which part of the app is showing. It never saves or sends anything. Scroll on purpose visits are left alone.
